newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek sees 8-mth result drop due Cargotec.
newsitem.headline: Partek sees 8-mth result drop due Cargotec.

text.p: Finnish construction materials and cargo handling equipment group Partek Oy Ab said on Friday its January-August profit will be below the year-ago profit due to weak performance by the Cargotec division.

"Cargotec's operating profit, which was weak at the beginning of the year, has weakened during the summer, and no substantial improvement is expected at the end of the year," Partek said in a statement.
"The profit for the entire Partek group for the first eight months of the year will be below that of the corresponding period for 1995," it said.

Between January and August last year, Partek's profit after financial items was 115 million markka and operating profit 208 million. The eight-month operating profit for cargo handling equipment division Cargotec was 102 million markka last year.
In the first four months of this year, Partek's operating profit was nearly halved to 41.6 million markka and Cargotec's operating profit fell by more than half to 22.6 million.

Demand for cargo handling equipment had been "clearly weaker" than expected, Partek said. Especially in Germany -- its biggest single market -- sales of cargo cranes and demountable load handling systems had "dropped significantly", it said.
"The strong Swedish crown and Finnish markka have weakened Cargotec's price competitiveness," Partek added.
The company saw no signs of a pick-up in demand. Cargotec's expansion in Asia and America had not yet been sufficient to offset "the weak sales and profit development in Europe".
Partek will reorganise Cargotec to reduce costs and improve customer service. It said sales networks would be streamlined and cooperation between production facilities strengthened.
The workforce would be cut by over 250 people this year. In 1995, Cargotec employed 2,753 people.
